comparison.objective: Detach two apples by lifting and twisting, then place them gently in a bucket.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-direction-sensitive fruit detachment and damage-free placement.
comparison.success_condition: Apples rest in the bucket with stems retained, spurs intact, no drops, and released stillness.
comparison.reason: Selective biological detachment and gentle harvesting differ from preserving a mechanical screw setting while locking and cycling it.
